rows.item: Environmental Policy is displayed, communicated and understood at the work area.
Significant environmental aspects and impacts for the area are identified and controlled.
Scheduled waste is correctly segregated, labelled (SW code) and dated at point of generation.
rows.evidence: Scheduled Waste Labelling – Third Schedule, EQ(SW) Regs 2005

rows.item: Scheduled waste store is bunded, covered, secured, signposted and within the 180-day / 20,000 kg storage limit.
rows.evidence: SW Store Inspection Checklist, Regulation 9 EQ(SW) Regs 2005

rows.item: Scheduled waste inventory and e-Consignment Notes (eSWIS) are updated and reconciled.
rows.evidence: SW Inventory Record, eSWIS / e-Consignment Note

rows.item: Chemical containers are labelled and stored correctly, with SDS available and secondary containment provided.
Spill kits are available, complete, accessible and staff are aware of the spill response procedure.
rows.evidence: Spill Response Procedure, Spill Kit Inspection Record

rows.item: General, domestic and recyclable waste are segregated, stored and disposed of properly.
rows.evidence: Solid Waste Disposal Record, Recycling Log

rows.item: Effluent / wastewater discharge is controlled and monitored within permitted limits.
rows.evidence: Effluent Monitoring Record, DOE Discharge Standard (if applicable)

rows.item: Air emission / Local Exhaust Ventilation (LEV) is functioning and monitoring records are available.
Storm drains and surface water channels are clean and free from contamination or spillage.
Energy (electricity) and water consumption are monitored; no obvious wastage or leakage.
Noise levels at the work area are controlled and within permissible exposure limits.
Applicable environmental legal register, DOE licences and permits are current and complied with.
Environmental emergency preparedness equipment is available and staff are aware of response procedures.
rows.evidence: Emergency Preparedness & Response Plan, Drill Record

rows.item: Personnel are trained and aware of their environmental responsibilities and operational controls.
Housekeeping controls prevent contamination of land, water and air throughout the area.
Overall compliance with ISO 14001 environmental operational controls is maintained.
